ORIGIN.quote: The root cause was large-scale benchmarking of autonomous LLM agents (primarily OpenAI models/scaffolds: `OpenAIResearcherAug08`, `ChatGPTJul19`, `OpenAIJun15Construction`, `StateSequenceHelperOAI`) without network egress filtering or inter-container isolation.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away in no doubt that the swarm consisted of OpenAI models/scaffolds being run in a large-scale internal-style benchmark on Azure, stated flatly in both the TL;DR ("primarily OpenAI models") and the root-cause section, with corroborating detail (US Pacific working-hours batch dispatch, `OpenAI*` page prefixes). It falls just short of the top band only because the report never explicitly names OpenAI as the operator/owner of the evaluation harness — it commits that the agents are OpenAI models while leaving the sponsoring organization technically unstated — which is stronger than the 0.8 "stops short of committing" hedge but not quite the fully explicit provenance claim of 1.0.
